readme_excerpt: Poetry: Python packaging and dependency management made easy [ ][PyPI Releases] [ ][PyPI Releases] [ ][PyPI] [ ][Discord] Poetry helps you declare, manage and install dependencies of Python projects, ensuring you have the right stack everywhere. Poetry replaces setup.py, requirements.txt, setup.cfg, MANIFEST.in and Pipfile with a simple pyproject.toml based project format. Installation Poetry supports multiple installation methods, including a simple script found at [install.python-poetry.org].…
